notes.title: Bubble People hotfix patch #5
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thanks for your feedback, a feature is fixed:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a minor text bug.
[/olist]

[h1]There are also questions about 12 levels and unlocking achievements[/h1]

Some players in the process of playing, the occurrence of problems such as stuck levels or achievements can not be displayed.
Visually tested, in general, can be correctly triggered, I also hope to collect more bugs generated by the situation.

Here I suggest.
[olist]
[*] check your connection with the Steam server.
[*] If the connection with Steam server is valid, you can try the following method.
[/olist]
Find C:\Users\"username"\AppData\Local\Bubble_People\savedata.ini and open "savedata.ini" with Notepad.
After adding or replacing the following characters, save and run the game.

[Achievement].
achievement_event_1="1.000000"
